title: Intent Review Questions
description: Deterministic reviewer questions for intent analysis.

entries.title: Narrative Question
entries.description: What does the scene mean as a whole?

entries.title: Speaker Question
entries.description: Who is speaking or narrating this intent?

entries.title: Target Question
entries.description: Who or what is being addressed?

entries.title: Intent Question
entries.description: What intent is the speaker actually expressing?

entries.title: Context Question
entries.description: Does the surrounding scene change the reading?

entries.title: Evidence Question
entries.description: Which literal text supports the conclusion?

entries.title: Concept Question
entries.description: Which intent concept is most plausible?

entries.title: Confidence Question
entries.description: How confident should the reviewer be?
